changelog:
personwise-developer-quickstart 2.1.9

- Skill can now only handle other course-creation requests if the user explicitly asks for them with this Skill.
- Skill explicitly requires explicit user approval before installing or updating the PersonWise CLI; description and instructions clarified.
- Tightened policy on CLI/service selection: only switch PersonWise market or accounts if the user explicitly asks; clarified account restrictions.
- `allowed-tools` and explicit Bash permission metadata added.
- Updated skill invocation attribution version to 2.1.9; removed outdated file `skill-card.md`.
summary: Turn API docs into an askable digital-human first-call course.
